subject.title: improve(qa): align Telegram coverage with startup behavior

question: Should maintainers land the profile-removal parent first and require this Telegram child to be rebased and revalidated on the resulting `main` head before accepting the stack?
rationale: The child intentionally depends on an open architecture refactor, and only maintainers can decide whether that parent direction is accepted; a pre-parent result cannot establish the final smoke-selection contract.

options.title: Land parent, then refresh child
options.body: Merge or otherwise resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114055 first, then rebase this PR and require focused final-head QA smoke and coverage proof.

options.title: Adopt the Telegram work independently
options.body: If the parent will not land, ask for a narrow replacement that applies the Telegram evidence changes directly to current `main` without preserving the stack dependency.

recommendation.title: Land parent, then refresh child
recommendation.body: Merge or otherwise resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114055 first, then rebase this PR and require focused final-head QA smoke and coverage proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current two-PR QA stack and can prepare the required rebased validation after a maintainer resolves the parent direction.
